integrity.computation: Standard-library independent recurrence verifier corroborates but does not prove unrestricted assertions.
integrity.proof_method: Finite multinomial identity, Legendre factorial valuations, two-adic dominant terms, and binary Hamming-weight enumeration.
integrity.scope: Infinite all-index proof for the two noncritical coefficient-valuation regions; exact construction showing boundary nonuniformity; exact primitive dyadic histogram.

limitations: The complete phase formulas require nonzero integers \(b,c\) and omit the critical line \(\nu_2(c)=2\nu_2(b)-1\); the boundary is shown nonuniform rather than classified.
The correction modulo four is a congruence in the two-adic integers, not a claim of ordinary integer quotient.
No corresponding all-index theorem for odd primes or independent historical priority certification is established.
title: Two-adic phases and a sharp boundary for generalized central trinomial coefficients
